crossRefs.note: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the…
Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.
How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
“Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,
who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

translations.web: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
translations.bsb: Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, even the purest gold.
translations.kjv: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
translations.asv: Therefore I love thy commandments Above gold, yea, above fine gold.
